name: The Drowned Repose
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: encyclopedia cover illustration for Avarenne, a mature late-industrial occult fantasy novel. Scene: Rain-swollen river beside an old funerary quay, four small anchored memorial posts partly submerged, silver-grey ripples and extremely subtle spectral impressions confined near the posts, raised maintenance walkway; ritual illustration of custody, not a crowd of invading undead. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, tactile architecture and believable materials, dramatic but readable light, atmospheric depth. One coherent scene, landscape 3:2. Show only the specified bounded manifestation; supernatural graphic traces are illustrative, never game interface. Anonymous adult figures only when specified, no named canonical character. No legible text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, card frame or collage. No additional creature, portal, deity, avatar or city-wide catastrophe. Avoid exaggerating the effect beyond its local source.
visual_caption: Rappresentazione rituale della custodia funeraria: le impressioni spirituali non sono automaticamente visibili a un osservatore ordinario. Ricostruzione illustrativa, non prova diagnostica o fonte di nuove capacità.
visual_review: APPROVATA: scena, limiti illustrativi e assenza di poteri aggiuntivi verificati
